title: dissolve
description: 고체를 액체에 녹이거나, 조직·감정을 없애거나 해체할 때 쓰입니다.
화학·요리 맥락에서는 물리적 용해, 비즈니스·정치에서는 해산, 감정에서는 긴장이나 갈등이 풀리는 뉘앙스로 자주 쓰입니다.
예: "Sugar dissolves quickly in hot water." (설탕은 뜨거운 물에 빨리 녹아요.)

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is the sugar gone yet?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Almost. Just give it a few more seconds to dissolve completely.
lines.meaning: 거의. 완전히 녹을 때까지 조금만 더 기다려.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What happened to their company?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: They decided to dissolve it last month after running out of funding.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You look much more relaxed now.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yeah, once we started talking everything just dissolved.
lines.meaning: 응, 이야기 시작하니까 모든 긴장이 그냥 사라지더라.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How should I take this powder?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Just dissolve it in a glass of water and drink it all at once.
lines.meaning: 물에 녹여서 한 번에 다 마시면 돼.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Did you hear the news?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The prime minister is going to dissolve parliament next week.
lines.meaning: 총리가 다음 주에 의회를 해산할 거래.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Should we bring this up again at the meeting?
lines.meaning: 이 문제를 회의에서 다시 꺼내야 할까?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I wouldn’t. It’ll probably dissolve on its own if we just wait.
lines.meaning: 안 그래도 될 것 같아. 그냥 기다리면 알아서 사라질 거야.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What happens when you stir it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The salt dissolves and the water becomes clear again.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are you two still working together?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, we dissolved the partnership after the project ended.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: He was really angry earlier.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I know, but his anger dissolved pretty quickly once he heard the full story.
lines.meaning: 알아. 근데 전체 이야기를 듣고 나니까 화가 금방 풀리더라.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I can’t swallow the whole capsule.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You can open it and dissolve the powder in juice if that’s easier.
lines.meaning: 열어 가지고 가루를 주스에 녹여 먹어도 돼. 그게 더 쉽다면.
